Triage (maintainer-authorized one-off pass, 2026-08-09, registered on #6015): **promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`** (routing `repo:objectui` kept). Dormant today, but the fix is three `type="button"` attributes with an in-family precedent (objectui#3344) — holding costs more than fixing, and the failure mode when composition changes (a filter click submitting the enclosing form) is the silent kind. The filing's harder second half (making the primitive default to `type="button"` in `@object-ui/components`) is explicitly NOT in scope of this card — that is a separate design card if ever wanted.
